Container.Name: wellnessquest-frontend
Container.Overview:
WellnessQuest PWA (Next.js 15 App Router, standalone build). Serves the UI and proxies `/api/v1/*` to the backend container via a Next.js SSR rewrite.
Requires: - Custom docker network `wellnessquest` (same one the backend is on). - The wellnessquest-backend container reachable at the URL set in BACKEND_UPSTREAM (default `http://wellnessquest-backend:8000`).
Container.Requires: Custom docker network `wellnessquest` and a wellnessquest-backend container on that network. See docs/unraid.md.

Config.Name: App port
Config.Description: Host port that maps to the Next.js server port (3000). This is what your phone / HA hits.

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE
Config.Description: API path prefix the frontend bundles into the client. The Next.js rewrite then proxies it to BACKEND_UPSTREAM.

Config.Name: BACKEND_UPSTREAM
Config.Description: Internal URL Next.js uses to reach the backend container (server-side rewrite target). Must match the backend container's name on the wellnessquest network.
